result.title: Tracking Any Point with Agentic Visual Reasoning
result.summary: A general-purpose Vision-Language Model (VLM) has surpassed expert vision models in many domains such as object detection and video recognition. However, point correspondence is known to be challenging for VLMs since it goes beyond object-level recognition: it requires pixel-level localization of the same physical surface point across observations, even when appearance changes or the point disappears and later reappears. In this paper, we introduce AgenTAP, a VLM-based agent that directly predicts point coordinates and visibility and actively reasons over videos. Starting from its own estimate, the agent autonomously chooses what to inspect and uses the resulting evidence to verify point identity and refine its predictions. With GPT-6 Astra, it surpasses expert vision models in both point localization and visibility prediction, without correspondence-specific fine-tuning. We further use AgenTAP to re-identify physical points after disappearance and reconnect fragmented tracks, constructing EgoTAP-4D, a dataset of 3D point trajectories in long real-world egocentric videos. On sampled reappearing points, its predictions approach human agreement, and adding EgoTAP-4D to D4RT training improves average 3D tracking performance.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AgenTAP：一个基于 VLM 的 agent，在视频中直接预测点坐标与可见性，并从自身初始估计出发自主决定查看哪些区域，用所得证据核验点身份、迭代修正预测；工作还借此重连断轨并构建 EgoTAP-4D 长时自我中心视频 3D 点轨迹数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 把 VLM 推理组织成「看哪里—取证据—修正估计」的多轮循环，直接对应 LVR 关注的视觉证据筛选、动态计算与停止决策，提供可对照的显式推理基线；但其状态停留在坐标与文本证据，是否/如何以 latent 表示承载像素级几何信息可供核查。
